name: Dharani Penu
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Dharani Penu organizes cultivators around enforceable territorial claims and protection from mining runoff. The movement presses for local review of extraction rights as southern institutions consolidate. The University register proposes a connection to Vijayan Watershed Compact. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
